publisher: Kök is published by Techtactoe App Studio.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body: Your journey photos stay on your phone. Kök uploads a photo only when you ask for an AI preview, and both that photo and the resulting preview image are deleted from our servers within 30 days. Kök shows no ads and does not sell your data. Kök is not medical advice.

sections.heading: What stays on your device
sections.body: Your operation date, progress photos, shed log and clinic name are stored only on your device. Kök never uploads journey photos. They are included in your phone's own backup (iCloud or Android Auto Backup) if you have that turned on.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: An anonymous account ID (Firebase Authentication), so you do not need to give a name or email. Your credit balance and purchase status. Your language and notification choices. Usage events, crash reports and performance data (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance Monitoring). A push token, only if you allow notifications. If you create a preview: the one photo you choose, the style and quality you pick, and the resulting preview. If you join the optional same-week group: your operation date, goal and kind of journey, and nothing else. We do not collect your name, contacts or precise location. Kök does not track you across other apps or websites and does not use your advertising identifier.

sections.heading: AI previews
sections.body: When you create a preview, the photo you picked is uploaded to our servers and processed by fal.ai, which runs OpenAI image models on our behalf. Kök asks for your agreement before the first upload, and that notice names these providers. The photo is used only to produce that preview. We do not use your photos to train AI models. The uploaded photo and the preview image are deleted from our servers within 30 days, so save a preview to your photo library if you want to keep it. Every preview is an AI illustration, not a prediction of your result.

sections.heading: Service providers
sections.body: We share data only with companies that process it for us: Google Firebase (account, database, file storage, functions, analytics, crash reporting, performance, remote configuration, app integrity checks and push notifications); fal.ai and the OpenAI image models it runs (AI previews); RevenueCat (subscriptions and purchases); Apple and Google (payments and app distribution). Kök contains no advertising and shares no data with advertisers.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
sections.body: Journey data: on your device until you delete it. Uploaded preview photos and preview images: at most 30 days on our servers. Usage and crash data: up to 14 months. Purchase records: as long as tax and accounting law require. Reports you send about a preview: as long as needed to review and act on them.

sections.heading: Your choices and deletion
sections.body: In Settings, Data and privacy, Delete all my data removes your journey photos, shed log and previews from this device. In Settings, Account, Delete account removes your account, credits, previews and any uploaded photo from our servers right away and clears your journey on the device. You can also turn notifications off there. Nothing is uploaded unless you create a preview. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription: cancel it in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR, Turkey's KVKK or California's CCPA) you may have rights to access, correct, delete or export your data and to withdraw consent. To make a request, email techtactoeappstudio@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: Kök is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: Kök is an education and tracking tool. It does not diagnose, treat or predict anything, and its timeline shows typical ranges only. For any concern, contact your clinic or a doctor.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
sections.body: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it. Questions or requests: techtactoeappstudio@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Using Kök
sections.body: Kök helps you follow a hair transplant, PRP or similar hair-restoration journey with your own photos and a typical timeline, and lets you create AI previews. You must be an adult and able to enter this agreement. By using Kök you accept these terms.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: Kök is not a medical device and does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Timelines and guides describe what is typical and are not a promise about your result. If you notice fever, spreading redness, pus, severe pain or heavy bleeding, contact your clinic or a doctor.

sections.heading: AI previews
sections.body: A preview is an AI illustration made from your photo. It is not a prediction, a promise or a plan for your result, and it does not show graft counts. The free onboarding preview carries a watermark. Previews are kept for 30 days, so save one to your photo library to keep it. Use previews responsibly and do not present one as a real photograph.

sections.heading: Photos and content
sections.body: Only use photos of yourself, or of someone who clearly agreed. Do not upload minors, public figures, or anything sexual, hateful, harassing, deceptive or illegal. We may block content and suspend access that breaks these rules. You can report any preview from its screen.

sections.heading: Subscriptions and credits
sections.body: Kök Pro is offered as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription at the price your store shows. There is no free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your App Store or Google Play account settings, and refunds follow Apple's or Google's rules. Credit packs are one-time purchases. A standard preview uses 1 credit and an HD preview uses 3. If a preview fails, its credits are returned automatically. Credits have no cash value and cannot be transferred. You can restore purchases from the paywall or Settings.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: You keep ownership of your photos and previews. You give us a limited permission to process what you upload only to provide the service you asked for.

sections.heading: Availability and liability
sections.body: Kök is provided as is and as available. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages, and nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law that cannot be waived.

sections.heading: Ending your use
sections.body: You can stop using Kök and delete your account at any time in Settings. We may change these terms and will update the date when we do.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Techtactoe App Studio, techtactoeappstudio@gmail.com.

sections.heading: What a preview is
sections.body: A preview is an AI illustration of how a chosen style might look on your photo. It is not a prediction of your result, and a label saying so stays visible on every preview.

sections.heading: What is sent
sections.body: Only the one photo you choose for that preview, plus the style and quality you picked. Your journey photos are never uploaded. Before the first upload Kök asks for your agreement.

sections.heading: Who processes it
sections.body: fal.ai runs OpenAI image models on our behalf. We use them only to make your preview and do not use your photos to train AI models. The uploaded photo and the preview image are deleted from our servers within 30 days.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.body: Results can be imperfect or unrealistic. The free onboarding preview carries a watermark. Kök never shows graft counts, stages or outcome promises.

sections.heading: Reporting and deleting
sections.body: Report a preview from its screen and we review it within 48 hours. You can delete a preview any time, and deleting your account removes everything we hold.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Email techtactoeappstudio@gmail.com and include your app version (Settings, About). We usually reply within two business days.

sections.heading: A preview failed. Did I lose credits?
sections.body: No. Credits for a failed or canceled preview are returned automatically.

sections.heading: How do I cancel my subscription?
sections.body: On iPhone: Settings, your name, Subscriptions, Kök. On Android: Google Play, Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions. You can also open Settings, Manage subscription in Kök.

sections.heading: How do I restore purchases?
sections.body: Open the paywall or Settings and tap Restore.

sections.heading: How do I delete my data?
sections.body: Settings, Data and privacy, Delete all my data clears your journey and previews on this device. Settings, Account, Delete account deletes your account and everything we hold. You can also email us to request deletion.

sections.heading: Is this medical advice?
sections.body: No. Kök is an education and tracking tool. For anything worrying, contact your clinic or a doctor.
